_: Shared by EVERY apparel page — both polo families and the hats. Merged under _family-*.json, which is merged under the product's own file. Anything true of one design only belongs in the product file, not here.
_sizeguide: Measurements supplied by Cole 2026-07-31 as the ATHLETE FIT chart, in inches and centimeters. They are the manufacturer's chart, verbatim — the inch and cm columns are BOTH given and neither is converted from the other, so do not 'fix' a rounding difference between them. The chart's column header for XXL reads 2XL; the store's size option is XXL, and the columns here follow the store so the chart and the picker agree.
_sizeguide_scope: Lives here rather than in the two polo family files because the Classic and the Blade share one chart, and a 6x3x2 table copied twice is a table that will drift. build.py drops it for any product with no size axis, which is how the hats avoid rendering polo measurements.

sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.intro: Use the below chart as a guide.
sizeGuide.note: Garment measurements, laid flat — not body measurements. Chest is measured across the chest and doubled. If you are between sizes or you like more room across the chest, take the larger one.
